Inputs
meta.value: 10 most recent verified games for each of the 30 teams through Nov 17, 2026 (300 team-games). Box scores from FantasyData (most games), plus LandOfBasketball, Covers, SI.com, HoopsNightly, ESPN, NBA.com, CBS Sports and FantasyTeamAdvice where FantasyData wasn't reachable. Every game checked: player points sum to the team's final score. For 16 teams (ATL, BKN, CHA, CHI, DAL, DEN, HOU, IND, LAC, MIL, MIN, NOP, ORL, PHX, POR, SAC) one or two recent games had no reachable box score, so their 10 verified games start around Oct 21-23 instead of the latest 10. Opponent defensive rank/efficiency from the team-defense tab (ESPN opponent stats, 18 Nov 2026). Minutes rounded to the nearest minute.
